title: foundry event log line
description: One line of <foundry dir>/events.jsonl (rolled to events.<n>.jsonl past 3 MiB), appended by foundry's hooks from 0.4.0 (foundry ADR-0003). Each line is one JSON object matching this schema. Read by scripts/retro.py, which skips a line that isn't JSON or has a v it doesn't know, and counts the skips. No line holds message, prompt or report text (P8).

v.description: The line's shape. Goes up when a field is renamed or retyped.

ts.description: The engine clock, as toISOString() gives it (UTC, Z).

crew.description: The crew's name: its lead's spawn name, as reports/<crew>/ uses it.

agent.description: The agent the event is about, by its spawn name, else its id. For spawn: the new agent (the caller is by); for stall: the idle agent; for tag: the lead; for report: the reporting agent; for budget-spent: the judge whose FAIL report spent the budget.

then.description: A crew's repair budget is spent: its judge FAIL count passed repairBudget (foundry ADR-0004 section 5).
A crew agent's or a lead's Agent call that the engine let through.

model.description: The model the call asked for, or null.

effort.description: The effort the call asked for, or null.

by.description: main for the foreman, else the calling agent's spawn name; factory for a workflow crew factory.ts started, workflow:<run id> for an agent a wave.js run started.

then.description: A Workflow wave.js run that ended without a result, recorded by factory finish (foundry ADR-0009). agent repeats crew; run is the Workflow run id (the run's transcript folder name).
One stall or idle-lead wake, when its prompt goes out.

minutes.description: Whole minutes idle, rounded down: the number the wake's prompt shows.

then.description: A lead's tagged message to main.

One WebFetch or WebSearch call (foundry ADR-0005 section 11). crew is the caller's crew slug, or main for a caller outside every crew; agent is the agent's name, or main for the main session. url (WebFetch) keeps scheme, host, port and path, with userinfo removed, each query value emptied and the fragment dropped; query (WebSearch) is cut to its first 200 characters. Written only while a plan.json exists.
A crew agent's final report written to its report file (not an interim stop).

marker.description: The report's leading marker, from its first non-empty line, or null.
